# t7.1 - Backend Security Remediation

## Summary
Removed cross-vendor customer order total disclosure, scoped demo initialization to the explicit `demo` profile, removed source credential defaults, and added focused regression coverage. Existing password hashes remain preserved and existing activation behavior remains opt-in.

## Changes
- `src/main/java/com/marketplace/dto/OrderResponse.java`: vendor projections report the sum of vendor-owned line totals.
- `src/main/java/com/marketplace/config/DemoDataInitializer.java`: initializer is active only for profile `demo`.
- `src/main/java/com/marketplace/config/DemoProperties.java`: credential fields start with no source password/email defaults.
- `src/main/resources/application.properties`: no default profile and environment-only demo credentials.
- `src/test/java/com/marketplace/dto/OrderResponseTests.java`: verifies multi-vendor totals are scoped.
- `src/test/java/com/marketplace/config/DemoDataInitializerTests.java`: verifies profile scope, absent defaults, credential validation, and password preservation.

## Upstream Artifacts Consumed
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t5-security.md` — S1-S3 findings and remediation requirements.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t2-backend.md` — vendor/admin API boundary.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t3-backend.md` — demo initialization and password preservation contract.

## Evidence Mapping
- `t5-security.md#S2` -> `OrderResponse.java#vendor projection` -> vendor subtotal regression test.
- `t5-security.md#S1` -> explicit `demo` profile and environment-only credentials.
- `t5-security.md#S3` -> no source credential defaults and `DemoDataInitializerTests#missingCredentialConfigurationFailsSafely`.
- `t2-backend.md#Vendor statistics` -> unchanged vendor repository aggregate and vendor-owned `sumVendorSales` boundary.
- `t3-backend.md#Demo initialization` -> existing-password preservation remains unchanged.
